remarks: Move in ready and beautifully designed inside and out with impeccable attention to detail, this gorgeous Colonial is the perfect home for those looking to live and entertain in style. Extensively renovated with comfort, convenience and energy efficiency in mind (see attached list of updates and improvements). Living room with stunning stack stone fireplace. Kitchen with shaker style cabinets, stainless farmhouse sink and appliances, and large dining area. Open to the spacious family room with vaulted ceiling and sliding doors leading to a beautiful deck. There is even a first floor bedroom and adjacent full bath perfect for those overnight guests or au pair. Upstairs are three additional large bedrooms. The spacious primary spans the entire width of the home and offers three large closets. The second and third upper bedrooms are generously proportioned and offer great storage. The outside space is just as wonderful with a comprehensive design by a landscape architect. You will love entertaining in your fully fenced back yard as you overlook the beautiful custom designed retaining wall with curated plantings, the matching custom designed firepit, and pool. The shed provides a space for all your tools. Sprinkler system and drip lines in front, with lines run in back for easy expansion. Efficient tankless water heater with the latest technology, new central a/c, additional foam insulation in the attic are just some features that add to the efficiency of this home.
